title: Boss: The Broken Shop Page
story: The Tag Goblin has been at this page. It looks fine at a glance, but a screen reader would trip on it everywhere. Fix it.
goal: Fix the page: a lang on html, a real title, h1 before h2, alt text, closed tags and a label tied to its input.
starter:

tests.label: The html tag has a lang
Exactly one h1, and it comes first
tests.js: var h = $$("h1,h2,h3"); return (h.length > 0 && h[0].tagName === "H1" && $$("h1").length === 1) || "the first heading should be the only h1"

tests.label: Every paragraph and list item is closed
tests.js: var s = document.documentElement.outerHTML; return $$("li").length === 2 && $$("p").length === 1 && !$("p ul") || "ul must not be inside a p, and li/p must be closed"

tests.label: The label is tied to the input
tests.js: var i = $("input[name=name]"); return !!(i && i.id && $("label[for=\"" + i.id + "\"]")) || "label for= must match the input id"

hints: Fix them one at a time and press Run: the Preview shows what the browser made of your code.
The h1 should be the shop name. The ul needs the p closed before it. Give the input an id and point the label at it.
